read.thesis: Regulated FPL capex of $12–13B and a 3.6 GW renewables/storage backlog drive 8%+ EPS CAGR, with Dominion merger filed and closing expected 2H 2027; supply-side signals are capex-led, not capacity discipline.

capex.quote: full-year capital investments are expected to be between $12 billion and $13 billion

triggers.label: Large-load interest 21 GW, 12 GW advanced
triggers.quote: FPL has roughly 21 gigawatts (GW) of large-load interest. Of that, FPL is in advanced discussions on 12 GW

triggers.label: Renewables backlog 35.1 GW
triggers.quote: NextEra Energy Resources' backlog now totals approximately 35.1 GW

triggers.label: 2026 adj EPS $3.92–4.02 reaffirmed
triggers.quote: continues to expect 2026 adjusted earnings per share to be in the range of $3.92 to $4.02 and is targeting the high end of that range

guidance.quote: continues to expect 2026 adjusted earnings per share to be in the range of $3.92 to $4.02
